title.narrative: No. of policies on violence or exploitation, aligned with applicable international minimum standards, available/endorsed(59346), Text

baseline.value: 0 No VAC policies; No Child Labour policies

target.value: 2022:Policy on economic exploitation initiated in 1 Province and 1 territory. Approved policy on VAC for 3 provinces and 2 territories.

actual.value: 2022:Policy development on economic exploitation initiated in Punjab and AJK. CP Policy (VAC) approved in 3 provinces and 2 territories

title.narrative: Country routinely collects and publishes key types of administrative data on violence, exploitation and abuse of children, disaggregated by age and sex, Text

baseline.value: 1996 Child Labour Survey; Study on online sexual exploitation of children; No Provincial Child Labour Surveys No VAC studies Baseline: 0

target.value: 2022:CLS completed in Punjab and KP and underway in Sindh, Balochistan, ICT and AJK

actual.value: 2022:CLS completed in Punjab, GB and KP. In Sindh, listing completed and data collection initiated, ICT listing exercise initiated, PAK PC1 awaiting approval, Balochistan constrained due to Floods but listing expected to start from January 2023
